arStrings.szText: I awoke convinced I had thunder in my skull until I saw the waves, crashing upon a stony shore. It seems I fell into my cups and emerged in Scosglen...in a strange bed in a strange home.
Cautiously, I stepped from the room and spied my friend Vasily, sitting with his wife at table. My embarrassment vanished when they turned to me. Hopeful looks on their faces.
They tell me the sacred barrow of their ancestors has been “touched by the infernal.” They say that this is why children have gone missing. Including their own son.
Apparently while drunk, I named myself a “scholar of the occult” and promised my help. I only pray that I can.
